en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.14
右侧改成可同时打开多个 agent 和文件的标签工作区；定时任务和编程助手也可以按风险自动判断，没有系统沙箱时命令仍要逐条确认。
- 点开子 agent 或文件会在右侧以标签打开，可以同时开多个，各自保持实时状态。标签可以排序，也能全屏、分屏或弹出独立窗口；悬停能看到卡片，划词可以加入对话或在侧边聊天里提问，侧边聊天支持多开。
- 子 agent 侧栏的能力和主栏对齐。
- 会话置顶后，会排在当前项目里的第一位，不再跑到项目外面。
- 灵动岛只在任务完成时提醒一次；工作台已经在屏幕上时，只弹出需要你处理或报警的通知。
- 用 CLI 第三方模型时，思考深度和主对话里选的一致。已去掉助手在本机登录，以及「外部 CLI」入口。
- 定时任务：授权到「可以跑命令」（L3）及以上，并且系统沙箱可用时，命令先交给命令审核，放行就直接跑。只有高风险、读凭据、永不放行类、审核不放行的，以及读了外部内容之后的操作才停下来问你。没有系统沙箱时（包括 Windows），L3 不会自动执行命令，改为逐条确认；改文件仍可自动发生。「按风险自动判断」和前台「全部自动」在这种情况下也不会自动放行命令。新建任务里「按风险自动判断」默认勾上，取消勾选才是每条命令都问。
- 派给编程助手（如 Codex）：做完自动收下，改动落到工作区，结果直接回到对话。后台任务同样按风险判断；没有系统沙箱时不会自动放行命令。
- 命令审核会把命令全文发给审核模型；已对常见密钥、令牌和本机主目录打码，但脱敏做不到全部秘密。
- 可重复的任务每次都回到「待开始」，等下一次触发，不会卡在「等你验收」。
- 给子代理发消息时，只能打到当前标签里已发现的子代理；主线程和未登记的 id 会被拒绝。
细节
- 预览里的工作区授权错误会留在界面上，不再一闪而过。
- Diff 草稿切换预览标签页时不会丢，保存前会校验版本，避免覆盖外部修改。
- 已经去掉「+」菜单里的「本会话的 Agents」；会话详情里的 Agents 列表还在。
English
The right side is now a tabbed workspace for several agents and files at once. Scheduled tasks and delegated coding assistants can also run with risk-based review; without an OS sandbox, commands still need confirmation one by one.
- Opening a sub-agent or a file adds a tab on the right. Several can stay open, each with its live state. Tabs can be reordered, maximized, split, or popped out. A hover card is available, and a text selection can be added to the conversation or asked about in a side chat; more than one side chat can be open.
- The sub-agent sidebar now matches the main pane.
- Pinning a conversation keeps it first inside the current project, instead of moving it outside the project.
- The Dynamic Island notifies once when a task finishes. When the workbench is already on screen, only items that need your action or an alert appear.
- Third-party CLI models use the same thinking depth as the main conversation. Local assistant sign-in and the "external CLI" entry are gone.
- Scheduled tasks: with a grant of L3 ("can run commands") or higher and an OS sandbox available, commands go to command review and run once cleared. Only high-risk steps, credential reads, never-allow classes, review rejections, and actions after reading outside content still stop to ask. Without an OS sandbox (including on Windows), L3 does not auto-run commands; they stay on per-command confirmation, while file edits can still happen automatically. "Judge by risk" and foreground "full auto" also will not auto-run commands in that case. "Judge by risk" is checked by default when creating a task; uncheck it to be asked about every command.
- Delegated coding assistants (such as Codex): finished work is accepted automatically, changes are landed in the working tree, and the result returns to the conversation. Background tasks also follow risk-based review; without an OS sandbox, commands are not auto-approved.
- Command review sends the full command to the review model. Common secrets, tokens, and the home directory are redacted first, but redaction cannot catch every secret.
- Recurring tasks return to "waiting for trigger" after each run instead of getting stuck on "awaiting acceptance".
- Messages to a sub-agent can only go to a discovered child of the current tab; the main thread and unregistered ids are rejected.
Details
- Workspace authorization errors in the preview stay visible instead of flashing by.
- Diff drafts survive switching preview tabs, and saves check the revision first so they do not overwrite outside changes.
- The unused "Agents in this session" item is gone from the + menu; the Agents list in session details remains.
